toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete polished standalone HTML file with inline CSS and vanilla JavaScript for a classic two-snake competitive Snake game. No dependencies or external resources. 30x30 grid rendered on canvas, continuous fixed timestep movement, food growth and scores. Include beautiful dark arcade design with mint and violet player colors, responsive layout, header, score cards, mode badge, canvas arena, keyboard instruction footer. Start menu overlay with selectable Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU modes and start button. Human vs Human P1 WASD, P2 arrows; CPU vs Human P1 CPU and P2 arrows; CPU vs CPU both CPU. Clearly show controllers dynamically and in menu. Game over overlay with winner/draw, reason, scores and restart and menu buttons. Enter starts/restarts, R restarts current mode, Escape returns to menu, Space pauses/unpauses; prevent scrolling for control keys. No reverse turns and at most one accepted human turn per tick. Start snake bodies length 4 positioned safely apart, facing toward center. CPU uses BFS to find shortest safe route toward food (mark bodies occupied, allow own vacating tail only if not growing) and chooses safe fallback with flood-fill area heuristic when no route; avoid predicting an opponent head cell and its possible next cells where feasible. Simultaneous movement collision logic: determine both next heads and growing flags, construct occupancy with tails removed only when not eating, detect walls, body collisions, shared head destination and head swaps; if any dies stop round immediately, surviving snake wins or both dead draw. Check collision before mutating bodies. Only spawn food on vacant squares; handle no empty space gracefully by ending round with score-based winner. Draw visible subtle 30x30 grid, distinct snakes with rounded segments and eyes indicating direction, bright food; display scores during gameplay and pause indication. Use requestAnimationFrame plus accumulator fixed timestep about 125ms, reset accumulator on start and resume, cap delta to avoid runaway after tab changes; single animation loop only. Pause automatically on window blur during play. Provide accessible semantic controls and labels, keyboard focus styles, aria-live status, responsive canvas that preserves square grid. Initial menu is visible and background arena preview is drawn. Implement all functionality fully with clean English code. Write the complete file now."}
